inputs.text: They’re packaging a frightening airport incident as an ICE-agent-hero story, with DHS itself releasing the video. That framing conveniently shifts attention from why a family was stuck in a crowded TSA line to the agency’s preferred image of its agent rushing in. The clip may show a real emergency, but it doesn’t prove the official narrative is the whole story; the release feels designed to steer public attention and manage perceptions of ICE.
